questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw white rice are produced by all agricultural farms across India in a single year?
reasoning: India produces roughly 130 million metric tonnes of milled and rough rice annually.
One metric tonne is equal to 1,000 kilograms.
Multiplying 130 million tonnes by 1,000 kilograms yields 130 billion kilograms.

questions.prompt: How many total individual pairs of shoes are manufactured by all commercial footwear factories located in Vietnam in a single year?
reasoning: Vietnam exports and produces over 1.2 billion pairs of shoes annually as a major global manufacturing hub.
Domestic consumption adds a minor amount, bringing the yearly total close to 1.2 billion pairs.

questions.prompt: How many total litres of water are contained within all active municipal water supply treatment reservoirs across the country of Brazil?
reasoning: Brazil has a large population of over 210 million people relying on municipal water systems.
Average treated storage per capita across large urban and regional treatment plants is roughly 200 litres.
Multiplying 210 million people by 200 litres gives approximately 42 to 45 billion litres total.
